notes: All three original violin sonatas, Grieg's only original works for violin, are already listed. The gaps are period arrangements. I have suggested only a few Hans Sitt arrangements published by C.F. Peters, Grieg's own publisher. Those attributions and titles are from memory and not verified, so all are marked medium confidence and should be checked against the editions before adding.
